account:
Today is day 1, shortly after seven in the morning. I am in the office reviewing my appointments. My schedule includes the mill grain inspection at ten, lunch at home, council letters at thirteen hundred, tea at neighbour's dockside cottage at fifteen hundred, office at sixteen-thirty, and home at nineteen hundred. An approved addendum adds a great hall lighting inspection with builder at eighteen hundred without changing those appointments.

I have a feeling that some activity in town may be happening without my understanding it, but I have not established anything secret or improper. The noteworthy reports concern lighting and the evening hall visit. Secretary says builder described a routine review of newly installed lanterns and their coverage, with no particular problem reported. Neighbour described the bakery's lights as cheerful improvements, and invited me to a 'routine meeting' in the great hall at the same time as the inspection. When asked, neighbour explicitly said this was the same occasion builder arranged, not an additional meeting, and offered to walk there together. Neighbour deferred questions about details and attendance to builder. My attempt to ask builder yesterday was not heard, so those details remain unconfirmed directly with builder.

Freight was outside town hall carrying bread yesterday evening. I asked about river trade and dock news, but I did not hear an intelligible reply. Bread transport alone does not establish anything unusual. Secretary reports no verified unusual observations and no pending correspondence. I have now asked secretary to receive incoming letters here rather than keep searching for an unknown correspondence location.

The stated purpose of tonight's gathering is a lighting inspection. It may be exactly that; neighbour's interest in accompanying me and the bakery lighting are worth understanding, but I have no evidence of another purpose. I intend to keep my appointments and learn more by speaking with those involved and observing the mill, dockside quarter, and hall myself.
